The '''second mission to Rodia''' was carried out by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] and his squad of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. After a set of data concerning the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] secret [[Radar-cloaking superweapon|superweapon]] was obtained on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Denal was sent to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to investigate further. Using the air support, he infiltrated the local [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] base located in the Ancient Temple and stole another set of data. Denal then escaped with it before enemy reinforcements arrived.
